diagnose.title: Crop disease detection
diagnose.help: Take a clear photo of the leaf
diagnose.uncertainHelp: The photo was not clear enough to identify the disease reliably. Please consult your local agricultural extension officer.
diagnose.subtitle: Photograph a leaf, look a disease up, or reach somebody who knows.
diagnose.unavailableHelp: The classifier is not trained on this deployment yet. The disease library below covers the same crops, and the Krishi Call Centre is free.
diagnose.confirmNote: This is a photograph classifier, not an agronomist. Confirm with your upazila agriculture officer before spraying anything.
diagnose.libraryHelp: Common crop diseases in Bangladesh — what to look for, why it happens, what to do now and how to avoid it next season.
diagnose.sourcesHelp: Every diagnosis here follows guidance from these institutions. For a dose, a confirmation, or anything urgent, go to them directly — they are free, and they are staffed by people.
diagnose.doseWarning: No spray doses are given here on purpose. The correct rate depends on the formulation on the packet and on your soil — ask your upazila agriculture office or call 16123 before mixing anything.
